identity_rule: A consumer must construct an explicitly NEW coupled root from this Hamiltonian/current/contact and its own declared electromagnetic coordinates. This is not a permission to splice into old Hubbard/Phi or claim identity with rich_charged_gauss/rich_photon states.

functions.build_sector(params,number): Dense pure H_N, states, spin[3], commuting position[3], angular[3], parity, geometric hopping, parameters/law. CAR basis combinations of12 modes; mode=2*site+spin; neutral4 index FASTEST. Dimensions N0=4,N1=48,N2=264. number and physicalcharge=-number explicit.
functions.solve(sector): Adds COMPLETE orthonormal Hermitian energies/vectors with parity/Jz resolution inside exact degeneracies. Full cubic dynamics does NOT conserve continuous total angular momentum; angular is a diagnostic operator only.
functions.current(sector,q,epsilon): Dense dimNx dimN number/link-phase current J(q,epsilon); exact straight-line integral over all offsite electronic hopping. q[3] real inverse-length; epsilon[3] may be complex. Physical electron EMcurrent=-returnvalue because A_phase=-A_EM.
functions.contact(sector,qout,epsout,qin,epsin): Dense mixed second source derivative, outgoing complex conjugate included; do not conjugate outgoing epsilon again. Physical EMcontact same returnvalue.
functions.spin_current(sector,q,epsilon,axis): Dense anticommutator {primitiveS_axis,J}/2, axis0/1/2. Physical charged-spin flux=-returnvalue; spin torque is i[H,S], not zero.
functions.scattering(sector,initial,final,qin,epsi: Exact molecular current/contact Kramers-Heisenberg response. Sector solved; full48 intermediates default. omega_out=omega+E_i-E_f. virtual parameter is only for an explicitly labeled OMITTED-SECTOR comparator. No recoil or dynamical photon feedback.
functions.car_source(origin,destination,mode,creat: Canonical exact c_mode^dagger (creation=True) or c_mode (False), destination<-origin with neutralorientor untouched; positive reference normalization and exchange sign from CAR.
functions.charged_spectral(sectors,ground_indices=: Requires solved N0,N1,N2 dictionary. Returns addition amplitudes[nground,264,12],removal amplitudes[nground,4,12],addition energies[nground,264],removal energies[nground,4]. Full neutral and charge virtual sectors; incoherent doublet average. Negative removal poles are holes.
functions.charged_green(data,omega,eta=.025): Full retarded12x12 spin/site G_ab at z=omega+i eta. Not a pole fit; keep source amplitudes if receiver needs projected orbitals. Caller responsible for positive eta.
functions.line_profile(q,epsilon,r1,r2): Exact dimensionless oriented link phase for plane-wave probe, including sinc. Useful when replacing external phase by explicit quantum-link or two-polarization coordinates in a NEW root.
